The '''Dram of Orphne''' was a glass vial which contained a sample of water from the mystical [[Orphne's Fountain/Legends|Fountain]] of [[Orphne/Legends|Orphne]]. Collected by an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during a humanitarian [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|mission]] to [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], the dram was lost when the agent mysteriously vanished. The vial was kept by the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] mystics that maintained the [[Great Seal/Legends|Great Seal]], and kept within one of the colossi that dotted the planet's surface, revering it as sacred and using it occasionally in their healing rituals.<ref name="NoP" />
